description: Defines the HpackFuzzUtil class with utilities for fuzz testing HPACK header compression in SPDY, including context initialization, header generation, input management, and bit-flipping functions.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing fuzzing functions for HPACK header compression testing.

classes.name: GeneratorContext
classes.description: HpackFuzzUtil nested struct holding header names and values for generation.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: HpackFuzzUtil nested struct managing input string and offset.

classes.name: FuzzerContext
classes.description: HpackFuzzUtil nested struct holding decoder and encoder stages for fuzzing.

methods.name: InitializeGeneratorContext
methods.description: Initializes a GeneratorContext with seed data.

methods.name: NextGeneratedHeaderSet
methods.description: Generates a header set from the generator context.

methods.name: SampleExponential
methods.description: Samples a size from an exponential distribution with a maximum bound.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Constructor for Input struct, initializes offset to zero.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns pointer to current position in input string.

methods.name: NextHeaderBlock
methods.description: Retrieves the next header block from input.

methods.name: HeaderBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns serialized length prefix for a header block.

methods.name: InitializeFuzzerContext
methods.description: Initializes a FuzzerContext with decoder and encoder stages.

methods.name: RunHeaderBlockThroughFuzzerStages
methods.description: Processes input block through fuzzing stages, returns success status.

methods.name: FlipBits
methods.description: Randomly flips bits in a buffer.
